messages:
monica: Quick sync — need social rollout plan for webinar 'Serving LLMs: cost & latency tradeoffs' next Tue 9am PT. We need: X thread (3 tweets + CTA), LinkedIn long post + 3-slide carousel, and short clip for organic. Benchmarks to highlight: ~2x lower per-token cost vs baseline, 20% avg latency reduction, deterministic SLOs. Who can own copy and routing?

alex: I can draft the X thread + CTAs. Will post schedule: primary post Tue 08:45 PT, follow-up threads at +30m and +3h. Need final numbers and screenshot assets.

liz: Design ETA: initial carousel mockups by Fri EOD. Can we freeze copy by Thu noon? Also need brand assets (logos, charts)

sam: For engagement, let's A/B two CTAs: 'Watch live' vs 'Register for recording' and add a pinned reply with resources. Also recommend 1 paid boost to targeted engineering cohorts.

alex: Draft X thread v1:
1) "New: Serving LLMs at predictable cost and latency. We cut per-token cost ~2x and improved median latency by 20%. Join our webinar Tue 9am PT — register: <link> #ml #inference"
2) Follow-up: short bullet on Dedicated and Private options
3) CTA reply: registration link + short form

monica: Nice. Can you include a benchmark graphic (latency/cost chart) and a 2-line narrative for the LinkedIn post? Keep voice more product-forward.

liz: Noted. @alex send the chart data + CSV. I'll produce 3 image slides: headline, benchmark chart, TL;DR value props.

ben: Sales note — please tag inbound leads in HubSpot with 'webinar-march' and include 'priority:high' for accounts >$50k ARR. I'll prep a 48h follow-up cadence for engaged accounts.

alex: Routing: I'll add UTM params and a hidden field on the form to auto-tag. Template utm_campaign=webinar_march_2026

amp-bot: calendar: Webinar created (Tue 2026-03-31 09:00 PT) — RSVP open: <calendar-link>

monica: Timeline recap: Thu noon - copy freeze; Fri EOD - design assets; Mon - rehearsal clip; Tue - post + live. Owners: copy=alex, design=liz, paid=sam, SDR follow-up=ben. 

sam: Also ask @ads-team for 1 small conversion test, budget $200. I'll open ticket.

liz: Quick Q: do we want closed captions on clip and 16:9 + 1:1 crops? I can export both.

monica: Yes to both. Add captions.

alex: I'll drop final thread and LinkedIn copy by Thu 11:30 so Liz can iterate. 

ben: I'll prepare a 3-email nurture: immediate thank-you, 48h content, 7-day CTA. Share list by Mon.

monica: Great. Callout — benchmark narrative must avoid direct competitor naming. Use 'industry baseline' instead. 

alex: Understood. Will phrase as 'vs industry baseline'.

liz: on it. Anything else?

monica: That's it for now. Thanks. :rocket:
